QUICK START

How to play

  1. Move & launch

    Drag left or right anywhere on the board to aim the paddle. Tap Launch to send the ball through the opening.

  2. Break the colored bricks

    Keep the balls bouncing with your paddle. Gray walls stay in place. Clear every colored brick to finish the stage.

  3. Catch the labeled boosts

    Move the paddle beneath a falling pickup. Touching a brick does not activate it. Each caught pickup applies once.

Your progress saves automatically.

No Save button is needed. You can leave the app and continue your field later. Optional sign-in syncs completed stages and history; your current field stays on this phone.

Lives & stages

Missing every ball costs one life. Broken bricks stay broken during that attempt. Complete all 12 starter stages to unlock stage 13, then clear journey stages in order.

Play at your pace

AUTO controls the paddle for you. 1×, 2× and 4× change playback speed. Both manual play and AUTO earn completion ticks.

Keyboard: ← → or A/D move · Space launches · P pauses.
